ideas.pitch: A live forensic terminal and log-reconstruction puzzle engine designed to simulate Dr. Meera Kapoor's final hours on SERVER EPOCH-01.
ideas.title: EpochGuard Terminal
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly matches the immersive lore of the hackathon theme, providing judges with a high-energy, interactive narrative demo rather than a standard slides-and-code presentation.

ideas.pitch: A real-time file carving and chunk-recovery tool that simulates stopping an active data-wipe script on a corrupted server.
ideas.title: WipeBar: Distributed Log Recovery
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by implementing low-level file reconstruction and concurrency control under a strict countdown timer.

ideas.pitch: An investigative graph intelligence tool that parses the surviving server logs to map out who had access, who was behind Dr. Kapoor, and flag anomalies.
ideas.title: Meera's Graph: Insider Threat Profiler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies proven graph intelligence techniques to an investigative mystery narrative, making the solution both analytically impressive and highly entertaining for judges.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router and query engine that lets investigators quickly search through unstructured farewell card messages and half-erased server logs.
ideas.title: Epoch-01 Semantic Log Query
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages efficient semantic routing to give judges an instant, lightning-fast search interface over messy narrative data during the live demo.

ideas.pitch: An automated AI agent framework orchestrated with BPMN workflows to autonomously analyze recovered server logs and run pre-deployment security diagnostics.
ideas.title: Agentic Recovery Squad
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines structured workflow orchestration with agentic execution, appealing to judges looking for robust architecture and human-in-the-loop control.
